Everyone who seeks treatment for substance use disorder deserves adequate care to get on the path of recovery.

I introduced a bill to study the effectiveness of residential recovery homes, and I'm glad to see it included in the mental health legislation we're passing today. https://t.co/eMbzAN4K8C

I am deeply concerned about the Japanese government’s handling of the case of Lt. Ridge Alkonis, a @USNavy officer who has not received fair treatment by Japanese courts. I am working closely with the Navy and @DeptofDefense to support Lt. Alkonis and I will not give up on him. https://t.co/kbNwKf619h

On #WorldAIDSDay we're thinking of those who've lost their battle with HIV/AIDS, and of those who are still living with this disease every day.

Today, we recommit to fighting stigma, expanding treatment, and defeating HIV/AIDS once and for all.

This morning, I tested positive for COVID during a routine test.

Fortunately, I am fully vaccinated and boosted, and only experiencing mild symptoms. I am isolating and working remotely.

I encourage everyone to get fully vaccinated, including both boosters.

Chrissy and I are keeping my colleague, friend, and defender of our democracy Jamie Raskin in our thoughts.

Jamie, we’re sending you positive energy as you begin treatment and we hope the knowledge of how loved and respected you are by all of us helps you through this hard time.

.@POTUS is right -- Everyone who seeks treatment for a substance use disorder deserves adequate care to get on the path of recovery.

We must invest in mental health care. #SOTU

It's simply unconscionable for any child to go hungry.

We must do more to ensure every child has the nutrition they need to grow and thrive year-round, and that's why I'm proud to introduce the Stop Child Hunger Act. https://t.co/ZgfkviZkV3

Last week, I visited the South Bay International Wastewater Treatment Plant. My San Diego Congressional colleagues and I are working to secure funding to better maintain and upgrade the plant so we can keep our beaches clean and end this pollution catastrophe. https://t.co/kyXFuYfrF6

I’m wishing @SteveScalise a speedy recovery as he begins treatment this week!
https://t.co/DnIJ2oMBSx

Had a great lunch at The Plot in Oceanside! Thanks Jessica, Davin, and team for a delicious meal! I will bring back to DC your lessons about how a whole-food, plant-based diet can help address the climate crisis and improve our health. https://t.co/G6juiZ9ElI

After visiting the South Bay International Wastewater Treatment Plant last month, I was eager to discuss how we can clean up the Tijuana River Valley and stop the pollution coming north to our communities’ beaches. We must not stop until the job is done.

In September, I joined my SD colleagues to request $310M to tackle wastewater pollution in the Tijuana River Valley.

I’m grateful to @POTUS for including this amount as part of his supplemental funding request. I’ll be fighting in Congress to pass it.

https://t.co/IURhWQswx2

As Thanksgiving approaches, @SDHungerCo reminds us there's still work to do to make sure no San Diegans go hungry.

Even one hungry child, veteran, or community member is too many. I'll continue to work to ensure everyone can have food on their table.

https://t.co/julvY0oqeI

Another sobering reminder that our beaches and bluffs are at risk of erosion. I’m proud to have secured funds to help restore beaches in Encinitas, Solana Beach, and San Clemente, but I also urge everyone to exercise extreme caution when near the bluffs.
https://t.co/GR6qq1iHQO

On National Black HIV/AIDS Awareness Day, let's reaffirm our commitment to global health equity by reauthorizing @pepfar. HIV disproportionately impacts Black communities, and we must ensure access to prevention and treatment is equitable. #EndHIVEpidemic

Thirty million kids will now have access to the food they need over summer vacation.

I joined @DepSecXoch at Mission Elementary to celebrate the permanent start of Summer EBT, which will ensure kids can get the nutrition benefits they need when schools close for the summer. https://t.co/1diYFOSeMw

I'm fighting to end food insecurity for children, veterans, and their families.
 
I've already introduced and passed bipartisan legislation that will help ensure families can get the support and nutrition they need. https://t.co/PH9lwH7fIY

As a parent, I know how important it is that every child has food to eat.
 
The permanent Summer EBT Program, which I championed, will help ensure millions of kids across the country have the nutrition benefits they need to grow and thrive. From @nbcsandiego https://t.co/kdoFEa941X

This year marks the 70thanniversary of Brown v. Board.

To mark this occasion, I met with local educational leaders in our community to discuss how we can work together to advance educational equity through student mental health, school health and nutrition, and more. https://t.co/IEKqFvCCz2

I helped secure over $950,000 for the water reclamation project in San Clemente. This will help provide overflow diversion and advanced treatment to upcycle runoff in Orange County. https://t.co/xc7s6Og3x8

I applaud @EPA for its new ruling to reduce “forever chemical” exposure in water.

We must do everything we can to ensure that our water is clean of chemicals and safe to drink.

https://t.co/1tkEVx11qr

As part of #InfrastructureWeek, I’m proud to announce that I helped secure $1.2 million for @southcoastwater to improve water treatment and distribution infrastructure in our district.

Learn more: https://t.co/xquaRjXzX0 https://t.co/mQdGPoldaA
Reminder that tomorrow is #ElectionDay! If you haven’t already, be sure to exercise your right to vote and make your way to the polls!

Dengue fever, a virus spread by mosquitos, is becoming more prevalent in our communities.

To stay safe, attempt to avoid mosquito bites when traveling and contact your medical provider or 211 if you show symptoms of dengue.

Read more here:
https://t.co/wlhsCEVIwA

Carbon monoxide is a silent killer—colorless, odorless, and deadly. This Carbon Monoxide Awareness Month, protect your loved ones by installing detectors, checking batteries, and knowing the symptoms of CO poisoning.

https://t.co/s0LbDSniQD
